map_name: ANME-SRB toy AOM community (koros anme-toy-thermo-model, V3.0/V4.0 topology) -- v3 escher-native layout
map_description:
Built with Escher's OWN add-reaction algorithm (ported from its real source, see escher_build_algorithms.py), not hand-rolled segments -- real bezier curves + primary/secondary metabolite spacing. Cofactors (h, na, h2o, ppi, hout, naout, pi, adp, atp -- all organism-suffixed variants) are secondary; everything else primary. Five tracks top-to-bottom: ANME main chain, ANME's C1-carrier cofactor loop, the shared H+/Na+ exchange bridge, SRB's redox cofactor loop, SRB main chain. Organism-private metabolites are labeled explicitly, e.g. atp[ANME] vs atp[SRB]. mphen/mphenh2 is the true interspecies meeting point (ANME_HDR/FPO/Rnf <-> SRB_Pcc) but is drawn as separate per-track nodes, not one shared node, since Escher's build radius (350px) can't span the ~700px row gap -- flagged for the user to connect by hand in the builder if wanted. Load flux/deltaG overlays at render time via build_escher_html.py. A first-pass layout meant for manual refinement, not a final figure.
